about: Guild Notices on the Ninewalls board by the tube-mouth counter: untimed bounties. Card head GUILD NOTICE, one verb TAKE, the word 'untimed' printed on every card. Body at most three lines.
head: GUILD NOTICE

notices.title: BRING BACK AN UNBROKEN SICKLE BLADE
body: Whole, edge and tang. A cracked blade
is scrap and I have scrap.
A whole one keeps an edge for a lifetime.
notices.done: Not a nick on it. Oro hung it over the forge.

notices.title: WALK THE SCAR END TO END UNSEEN
notices.from: the pit farmers of the lower terraces
body: Four hundred and eighty metres of it,
and every Instrument on the Holds can see it.
Show us it can be walked.
notices.ask: The Scar, end to end, never Flagged
notices.done: End to end. The farmers have stopped walking round it.

notices.title: NINE SCUTES FOR A FAN
body: A Tiller sheds its scutes like a pine
sheds bark. Nine of them, flat ones,
and I can make a Windwall that turns a blade.
notices.done: Nine scutes on the bench. Oro has started the rivets.

notices.title: PUMICE FOR THE DUST POTS
body: Light stone, the kind that floats.
The rim above the Jameo is full of it.
Three makes a pot. We need a dozen.
notices.done: Twelve pumice. The tube hands are grinding it already.
